description: Assemble the input bundle for the brand AI deliverables (a quarterly business review or a weekly report): the latest persisted snapshot, the brand's recorded strategy and KPI targets, the action-map readiness for the brand's networks, and the entitlement state. Use this to hand Claude one clean, structured input for a client-ready write-up; build a snapshot first with affiliate_build_brand_snapshot, and note it deliberately excludes the raw transaction rows (too large and unnecessary for a narrative). This is a paid brand-data tool gated by the local entitlement check; without entitlement it returns a structured entitlement_required result rather than data.
name: affiliate_get_brand_action_bundle
